run_convert_convnextv2_checkpoint: run the ConvNeXTV2 checkpoint conversion script to transform a Facebook checkpoint into a HuggingFace PyTorch model
convert_convnextv2_config: convert a ConvNeXTV2 checkpoint URL into a HuggingFace ConvNextV2Config with correct depths and hidden sizes
rename_convnextv2_keys: rename ConvNeXTV2 checkpoint state dict keys to match the HuggingFace ConvNextV2 model naming convention
convert_convnextv2_preprocessor: convert a ConvNeXTV2 image preprocessor with correct size, crop percentage, and normalization parameters
save_convnextv2_model_to_hub: save or push a converted ConvNeXTV2 model and its image preprocessor to the local filesystem or HuggingFace Hub
